releases.name: Pulse CC 0.3.1 — Built-in MCP, token-only setup
releases.body:
Pulse CC now includes its local Pulse Mac MCP connection. Download and open Pulse Mac, enable MCP in **Settings → Agent access**, then select **Pulse Mac** in `/pulse` and use **Paste token** to open Claude Code's configuration dialog. Paste the token, save, and reopen `/pulse`.

- **One setting:** Pulse Mac token. No manual MCP command, server URL, port, or refresh settings.
- **Clearer onboarding:** a Mac app introduction, download link, numbered setup steps, and a button to configure or update the token.
- **Native credentials:** Claude Code masks and stores the token; it is never saved in the plugin's watchlist store or sent as prompt text.
- **Read-only Mac view:** browse groups and choose which tickers appear above the prompt. Mac list management stays in the app; the independent Yahoo watchlist remains available.
- **Updated documentation:** setup instructions, update commands, and a first-connection panel screenshot.

The bundled server appears in `/mcp` as `plugin:pulse-cc:pulse`. Mac integration requires Claude Code running locally on the same Mac as Pulse, with the app open and MCP enabled.

### Update

```sh
claude plugin marketplace update pulse
claude plugin update pulse-cc@pulse
```

Restart Claude Code or run `/reload-plugins` to apply the update. Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or later**, with Mods enabled.

[Installation and connection guide](https://github.com/fatwang2/Pulse/tree/main/plugins/claude-code) · [Download Pulse Mac](https://www.pulseticker.app/)

releases.name: Pulse CC 0.3.0
releases.body:
Pulse CC can now connect to Pulse Mac over its local MCP server. Browse Mac watchlist groups and choose which tickers appear above the Claude Code prompt. Display selections stay local to the plugin; Mac watchlists remain read-only, and your independent Yahoo watchlist is preserved.

- Switch between Pulse CC and Pulse Mac using the new quote-source cards.
- Read Mac watchlists and cached quotes every five seconds by default, retaining provider timestamps and clearly labeling cached data when disconnected.
- Keep the connected status stable during background refreshes.
- Updated the panel styling, website link, setup guide, and English screenshot.

Requires Claude Code 2.1.287 or later with Mods enabled. Pulse Mac must run on the same Mac with Agent access enabled.

[Connect Pulse Mac](https://github.com/fatwang2/Pulse/tree/pulse-cc--v0.3.0/plugins/claude-code#connect-pulse-mac)

To update an existing installation:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace update pulse
claude plugin update pulse-cc@pulse
```

Restart Claude Code after updating.

Validation: 24 native Mods tests passed on Claude Code 2.1.287 and 2.1.288; plugin/marketplace validation and TypeScript checks passed. The local Pulse Mac MCP connection was also exercised with real watchlists and cached quotes.
